{{Quote|At 21:23:07 yesterday, materials were posted to this forum which potentially violated security parameters. Cularin holonet services hereby suspends this forum until further notice. Any individuals contributing further to this discussion will be brought in for questioning.|holosrv, posting on the Cularin holonet node on behalf of Cularin holonet services|<ref name="destabilization">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040105|text=Destabilization}}</ref>}}
'''Cularin holonet services''' was an organization in operation during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that had the power to shut down forums on the [[Cularin holonet node]] in response to suspected security breaches. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Operation False Horizon]], Cularin holonet services suspended a forum on the holonet node discussing a message shared by the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Tiny.f]] purporting to be a communication by [[Jir Tramsig]] of the [[Thaereian military]] that referenced a [[Thaereian]] plot to enact social and economic destabilization in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. The user [[holosrv]] posted a message on behalf of Cularin holonet services to announce that the information shared by Tiny.f potentially violated security rules and that individuals who continued to debate it would be taken for questioning.<ref name="destabilization" />

At a later time, users of the Cularin holonet node exchanged views on a decrypted communique from an undisclosed party shared by the slicer [[mstrslcr]] which many interpreted as a report by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] representative recommending intervention in the operation of the [[Almas Academy]]. Cularin holonet services assessed that the disclosure may have breached security protocols and suspended the forum. Holosrv left a message on the platform on behalf of Cularin holonet services to proclaim the suspension and to warn that further discussion of the message would result in arrest.<ref name="academic review">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20041007|text=Academic Review}}</ref>
